# Data Source: stripe_billing_credit_balance_transaction

A movement of a customer's billing credit balance: credit granted, or credit applied to an invoice or voided. Look one up by its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_billing_credit_balance_transaction" "granted" {
  id = "cbtxn_123"
}

output "credit_type" {
  value = data.stripe_billing_credit_balance_transaction.granted.credit.type
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the billing credit balance transaction to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `credit` - Credit details for this credit balance transaction. Only present if type is `credit`. See [`credit`](#credit) below.
* `credit_grant` - The credit grant associated with this credit balance transaction.
* `debit` - Debit details for this credit balance transaction. Only present if type is `debit`. See [`debit`](#debit) below.
* `effective_at` - The effective time of this credit balance transaction.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `test_clock` - ID of the test clock this credit balance transaction belongs to.
* `type` - The type of credit balance transaction (credit or debit). Possible values: `credit`, `debit`.

<a id="credit"></a>
### `credit`

The `credit` attribute supports:

* `amount` - See [`credit.amount`](#credit.amount) below.
* `credits_application_invoice_voided` - Details of the invoice to which the reinstated credits were originally applied. Only present if `type` is `credits_application_invoice_voided`. See [`credit.credits_application_invoice_voided`](#credit.credits_application_invoice_voided) below.
* `type` - The type of credit transaction. Possible values: `credits_application_invoice_voided`, `credits_granted`.

<a id="credit.amount"></a>
### `credit.amount`

The `credit.amount` attribute supports:

* `monetary` - The monetary amount. See [`credit.amount.monetary`](#credit.amount.monetary) below.
* `type` - The type of this amount. We currently only support `monetary` billing credits. Possible values: `monetary`.

<a id="credit.amount.monetary"></a>
### `credit.amount.monetary`

The `credit.amount.monetary` attribute supports:

* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `value` - A positive integer representing the amount.

<a id="credit.credits_application_invoice_voided"></a>
### `credit.credits_application_invoice_voided`

The `credit.credits_application_invoice_voided` attribute supports:

* `invoice` - The invoice to which the reinstated billing credits were originally applied.
* `invoice_line_item` - The invoice line item to which the reinstated billing credits were originally applied.

<a id="debit"></a>
### `debit`

The `debit` attribute supports:

* `amount` - See [`debit.amount`](#debit.amount) below.
* `credits_applied` - Details of how the billing credits were applied to an invoice. Only present if `type` is `credits_applied`. See [`debit.credits_applied`](#debit.credits_applied) below.
* `type` - The type of debit transaction. Possible values: `credits_applied`, `credits_expired`, `credits_voided`.

<a id="debit.amount"></a>
### `debit.amount`

The `debit.amount` attribute supports:

* `monetary` - The monetary amount. See [`debit.amount.monetary`](#debit.amount.monetary) below.
* `type` - The type of this amount. We currently only support `monetary` billing credits. Possible values: `monetary`.

<a id="debit.amount.monetary"></a>
### `debit.amount.monetary`

The `debit.amount.monetary` attribute supports:

* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `value` - A positive integer representing the amount.

<a id="debit.credits_applied"></a>
### `debit.credits_applied`

The `debit.credits_applied` attribute supports:

* `invoice` - The invoice to which the billing credits were applied.
* `invoice_line_item` - The invoice line item to which the billing credits were applied.
